name: Attribute Value Pricing - Calculated Mode
what_it_tests: A line with an attribute adjustment in Calculated mode multiplies the base price by the attribute multiplier percent and bridges base/net via IF guards; must price correctly on first reprice
proc_mechanism: Attribute Value Pricing - Calculated Mode (Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Calculated'); Base_Price__c * Attribute_Multiplier_Pct__c; Calculated Mode Base/Net Bridge
expected_behavior: InputUnitPrice = Base_Price__c * multiplier; base and net bridged via IF(>0) guards

prior_run.actual: Force-reprice yields UnitPrice=0, NetUnitPrice=0, TotalLineAmount=0. AttributeMultiplierPct__c is WIPED 50->null by the reprice (pre-reprice pct=50, unit=935; post-reprice pct=None, all 0). Calculated branch entered (gate fields persist true/'Calculated') but multiplier null -> 100*null=0; Net Bridge also failed to floor to base (net=0 not 100). Deterministic across 3 fresh lines.
prior_run.defectStep: Attribute Value Pricing - Calculated Mode (V21 steps 13-16, incl. Calculated Mode Net Bridge)
prior_run.notes: Root cause class = SC-3390 stale-context / IsPriceImpacting (multiplier not hydrated, wiped to null on reprice) compounded by SC-3393 Calculated-mode null-guard gap (Net Bridge did not floor to Base_Price__c=100, net landed $0). Gate (Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Calculated') confirmed satisfied post-reprice, so the line entered the Calculated branch and still priced $0.
